title: The 3rd Annual Cape Cod Hydrangea Festival
bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder June 29, 2017

View Harwich’s finest blooms “Gardens By The Sea” Thursday, July 13 from 10 to 4 pm

Sponsored by the Cape Cod Chamber of Commerce, The Cape Cod Hydrangea Festival is an annual celebration of the region’s blue, pink, and white signature flowers! All garden tour proceeds benefit local nonprofits. Members of The Guild of Harwich Artists along with The Garden Club of Harwich will participate in the festival on Thursday, July 13, “Gardens By The Sea”.

View up to date details of the Cape Cod Hydrangea Festival on the Cape Cod Chamber of Commerce’s website. Garden tours are $5 per person per garden, cash only day of at gardens. Each garden is open from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. and only on the days specified. All garden tours are rain or shine and nonrefundable.
